SKETCH PR2 addendum posted on STORY-1662 (the claude --bg path of BUG-2207); please rule on Q-a/Q-b.
Root cause: claude --bg sessions run under the claude daemon's spare bg-pty-host and inherit the DAEMON's env (advisor role, grant and purpose), so the recipe's env changes never reach the lane. This lane shows it.
PR2 starts after #2829 merges (currently OPEN at b14a826, awaiting the operator). This session is past its context ceiling: recommend PR2 runs in a fresh lane briefed from the addendum.
